_about: The Write page's keyboard: the two presets' number orders, the Return and Tab flow (Final Draft's defaults), and the SmartType word lists. Content, not code (CLAUDE.md rule 2) — src/lib/write-keys.js reads it, src/ui/smarttype.js and src/ui/write-shortcuts.js present it. Element type ids are the ones src/lib/script.js defines; an id this build does not know ("shot" before the page view landed, "general") is skipped or aliased, never invented.

hints._about: The Script page's hint strip: one line per element type, what it is for. Enter / Tab targets are derived from returnNext and tab above, never written here.
hints.scene: Where and when: INT. or EXT., the place, then DAY or NIGHT.
hints.action: What we see and hear, in the present tense. Keep it to what a camera can show.
hints.character: The speaker’s name in CAPS. Add (V.O.) or (O.S.) when they are heard but not seen.
hints.paren: A short direction for how a line is said — use sparingly.
hints.dialogue: What the character says, as they would say it.
hints.transition: How we leave the scene — CUT TO:, DISSOLVE TO:. Most scripts need very few.
hints.shot: A specific camera angle, only when the story needs it.
hints.general: Free text that is not one of the standard elements.

learnTopics._about: Element type → src/data/learn.json topic id for the hint strip's 'What is…?' box.
